verdict.rationale: First-party docs show PBR materials, Lumen as the default dynamic global illumination and reflections system, and post-processing effects such as depth of field, auto exposure and bloom. Community reports corroborate the lighting quality, including Lumen running well in software on modest GPUs. However, no evidence item documents a shadowing system, so one required element of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: documented shadow rendering (dynamic or baked shadows), and baked/static lighting documentation as an alternative to Lumen.

support.subject: As a game developer, the engine ships a modern production 3D renderer — PBR materials, global illumination or baked lighting, shadows, post-processing

citations.quote: Physically based rendering (PBR) means that surfaces approximate the way light behaves in the real world
Lumen is Unreal Engine's fully dynamic global illumination and reflections system that is designed for next-generation consoles, and it is the default global illumination and reflections system.
Post Process Effects — Learn about the effects that can be applied through placed-volumes and cameras.
The difference between RT hardware and just software is purely performance, but performance is good with just software.
